# Gradia

> Gradia is a next-generation hiring and career platform connecting talented candidates with employers across IT, Banking, Education, Civil Engineering, Film & Media, and other industries. Features AI-powered resume analysis, mock interviews, skill assessments, mentorship, and end-to-end recruitment pipelines.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover your next career move with AI-powered job matching and resume tools.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Browse and apply to curated job openings across multiple industries.
- [Companies](/companies): Explore partner companies hiring through Gradia.
- [About](/about): Learn about Gradia's mission to transform hiring and career growth.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach out to the Gradia team for support or partnerships.
- [Pricing](/pricing): View wallet-based pricing for resume analysis, mock interviews, and premium features.
- [FAQ](/faq): Find answers to common questions about hiring, assessments, and platform usage.
- [Careers](/careers): Explore open positions at Gradia itself.
- [Blog](/blog): Read career tips, industry insights, and hiring best practices.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Understand how Gradia handles user data and privacy.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms-of-service): Review the terms of service for using Gradia.

## Candidate Features

- [Candidate Signup](/candidate/signup): Register as a job seeker to access jobs, AI resume analysis, and mock interviews.
- [Candidate Dashboard](/candidate/dashboard): Manage applications, track interview progress, and view job matches.

## Employer Features

- [Employer Signup](/employer/signup): Register as an employer to post jobs and manage hiring pipelines.
- [Employer Dashboard](/employer/dashboard): Post vacancies, manage applicants, and configure multi-stage interview pipelines.

## Optional

- [Freelancer Portal](/freelancer): Access mentorship, portfolio tools, and freelance project listings (requires login).
- [EduTech Portal](/edutech): Educational tools and training programs for upskilling (requires login).
- [Admin Portal](/admin): Platform administration and management tools (restricted access).
